pair_detection.en: Below are two versions of the same web page (Version 1 and Version 2). Their content is identical, but exactly one version has been deliberately degraded in visual design. Carefully compare them and decide which version was degraded. Reply with only one JSON object and no prose or markdown: {"degraded_version":1} or {"degraded_version":2}.
pair_detection.zh: 下面是同一网页的 Version 1 和 Version 2，内容相同，但恰有一版被人为降低了视觉设计质量。请仔细比较并判断被退化的版本。只返回一个 JSON 对象，不要解释或使用 Markdown：{"degraded_version":1} 或 {"degraded_version":2}。

pair_attribution.en: Only after selecting the degraded version, classify its directly changed visual properties using zero or more of these exact labels: Typography (font family, size, weight, type scale, or table-text alignment); Color (semantic or peer accent colors); Spacing (gaps or spacing among peer elements); Layout & Reading Flow (element alignment, edge placement, or content order/hierarchy); Visual Consistency (container shape/style parameters such as corner radius, not a generic consequence of another dimension). Do not add secondary effects. Reply with only one JSON object and no prose or markdown. The object must have exactly one key named "dimensions" whose value is a JSON array containing zero or more exact labels above. If no label applies, return {"dimensions":[]}.
pair_attribution.zh: 只有在选定被退化版本后，才对其中被直接改动的视觉属性分类。只能使用以下精确英文标签：Typography（字体族、字号、字重、字阶或表格文字对齐）；Color（语义色或同级强调色）；Spacing（间隙或同级元素间距）；Layout & Reading Flow（元素对齐、边缘位置或内容顺序/层级）；Visual Consistency（容器形状/样式参数，例如圆角，不作为其他维度的泛化后果）。不要添加次生影响。只返回一个 JSON 对象，不要解释或使用 Markdown。对象只能有一个名为 dimensions 的键，其值是由上述精确英文标签组成的 JSON 数组；若没有适用标签，返回 {"dimensions":[]}。

pair_localization.en: Now localize the directly degraded outlier elements in Version {V}. The page is shown in detailed slices 1 through {N}; overview images are for navigation only and must never be boxed. Draw tight boxes around the abnormal elements themselves. For spacing problems, box only the abnormal outlier element or elements, not the empty gap and not normal reference peers. Do not box normal downstream content that only moved as a secondary reflow effect. Report one box per distinct directly affected region. If the same region appears in overlapping slices, choose a slice where the largest portion is visible and box only that visible part. Some final slices contain white padding; never include padding. Every box coordinate is an integer normalized to [0,1000] along its corresponding axis of the full fixed 1800-pixel-high slice canvas; these values are not CSS pixels or screenshot pixels. Use [x1,y1,x2,y2] with x1<x2 and y1<y2. Reply with exactly {"locations":[{"slice":2,"box":[100,200,300,400]}]} or {"locations":[]}, with no extra keys, prose, or markdown.
pair_localization.zh: 现在定位 Version {V} 中被直接退化的异常元素。页面详细切片编号为 1 至 {N}；overview 只用于导航，绝不能在 overview 上报框。框应尽量贴合异常元素本身。对于间距问题，只框异常的 outlier 元素，不要只框空白 gap，也不要把正常 reference peer 一起框入。不要框仅因次生 reflow 而移动的正常下游内容。每个直接受影响的独立区域报一个框；同一区域出现在重叠切片时，选择其可见面积最大的一片，并只框该片内可见部分。末片可能有白色补边，绝不能包含补边。每个坐标都是相对完整固定切片画布对应轴归一化到 [0,1000] 的整数；固定切片高度为 1800px，但坐标不是 CSS px 或截图 px。box 顺序为 [x1,y1,x2,y2]，且 x1<x2、y1<y2。只返回 {"locations":[{"slice":2,"box":[100,200,300,400]}]} 或 {"locations":[]}，不得有额外键、解释或 Markdown。

pair_joint.en: Below are two versions of the same web page (Version 1 and Version 2). Their content is identical, but exactly one version has been deliberately degraded in visual design. Treat all overview and slice images as evidence for one single page-pair case, not as a batch of separate cases; combine them into one diagnosis. In this single response, complete this ordered diagnosis chain: (1) decide which version was degraded; (2) for the version you selected, classify only its directly changed visual properties using zero or more exact labels: Typography (font family, size, weight, type scale, or table-text alignment), Color (semantic or peer accent colors), Spacing (gaps or spacing among peer elements), Layout & Reading Flow (element alignment, edge placement, or content order/hierarchy), Visual Consistency (container shape/style parameters such as corner radius, not a generic consequence of another dimension); and (3) localize the directly degraded outlier elements in that selected version. Use each dimension label at most once. A wrong degraded_version invalidates downstream attribution and localization in the formal end-to-end score. The detailed page images are numbered slices 1 through {N}; overview images are for navigation only and must never be boxed. Draw tight boxes around the abnormal elements themselves. For spacing problems, box only the abnormal outlier element or elements, not the empty gap and not normal reference peers. Do not box normal downstream content that only moved as a secondary reflow effect. Report one box per distinct directly affected region. If the same region appears in overlapping slices, choose a slice where the largest portion is visible and box only that visible part. Never include white padding. Each numbered detailed-slice canvas is {W} pixels wide and {H} pixels high. Choose exactly one coordinate_space and declare it globally for every locations[].box: use "normalized_1000" for integer coordinates on independently normalized axes from 0 to 1000, where horizontal u maps to u*{W}/1000 slice pixels and vertical v maps to v*{H}/1000 slice pixels; or use "slice_pixels" for integer coordinates directly on the slice canvas, where horizontal edges are in [0,{W}] and vertical edges are in [0,{H}]. Choose exactly one box_format and declare it globally for every box: use "xyxy" for [left,top,right,bottom] with left<right and top<bottom; or use "xywh" for [left,top,width,height] from the top-left corner with positive width and height. Every box must remain fully inside the declared coordinate space. Never mix coordinate spaces or box formats, and never use overview or full-page coordinates. Declare coordinate_space and box_format even when locations is empty. Return exactly ONE bare top-level JSON object with exactly the keys "degraded_version", "dimensions", "coordinate_space", "box_format", and "locations", and no prose or markdown. The response's top-level value must be the JSON object itself, never an array containing that object. The first non-whitespace character of your response must be { and the last non-whitespace character must be }. Example: {"degraded_version":1,"dimensions":["Color"],"coordinate_space":"normalized_1000","box_format":"xyxy","locations":[{"slice":2,"box":[100,200,300,400]}]}. degraded_version must be integer 1 or 2. If no dimension or region applies, use an empty array for that field.
pair_joint.zh: 下面是同一网页的 Version 1 和 Version 2，内容相同，但恰有一版被人为降低了视觉设计质量。请把所有 overview 和切片图片共同视为同一道页面配对题的证据，而不是一批独立题目；将它们合并为一次诊断。请在一次回答中按顺序完成诊断链：（1）判断被退化的版本；（2）只针对你选中的版本，用以下精确英文标签判断被直接改动的视觉维度：Typography、Color、Spacing、Layout & Reading Flow、Visual Consistency；（3）定位该选中版本中被直接退化的异常元素。每个维度标签最多使用一次。正式端到端评分中，degraded_version 一旦选错，后续归因和定位均不能得分。详细页面图片的切片编号为 1 至 {N}；overview 图片只用于导航，绝不能在 overview 上报框。框应尽量贴合异常元素本身。对于间距问题，只框异常的 outlier 元素，不要只框空白 gap，也不要把正常 reference peer 一起框入。不要框仅因次生 reflow 而移动的正常下游内容。每个直接受影响的独立区域报一个框；同一区域出现在重叠切片时，选择其可见面积最大的一片，并只框可见部分；绝不能包含白色补边。每个编号详细切片的画布宽 {W}px、高 {H}px。必须为所有 locations[].box 选择并全局声明一种 coordinate_space："normalized_1000" 表示每个轴分别归一化到 0 至 1000 的整数坐标，横向 u 对应 u*{W}/1000 切片像素，纵向 v 对应 v*{H}/1000 切片像素；"slice_pixels" 表示切片画布上的整数像素坐标，横向边界范围为 [0,{W}]，纵向边界范围为 [0,{H}]。还必须为所有 box 选择并全局声明一种 box_format："xyxy" 表示 [left,top,right,bottom]，要求 left<right 且 top<bottom；"xywh" 表示从左上角开始的 [left,top,width,height]，要求 width 和 height 为正。每个框都必须完全位于所声明的坐标空间内；不同框之间绝不能混用坐标空间或格式，也绝不能使用 overview 或整页坐标。即使 locations 为空，也必须声明 coordinate_space 和 box_format。只返回一个裸的顶层 JSON 对象，必须且只能包含 degraded_version、dimensions、coordinate_space、box_format、locations 五个键，不要解释或使用 Markdown。回答的顶层值必须就是这个 JSON 对象本身，绝不能是包含该对象的数组。回答的第一个非空白字符必须是 {，最后一个非空白字符必须是 }。例如：{"degraded_version":1,"dimensions":["Color"],"coordinate_space":"normalized_1000","box_format":"xyxy","locations":[{"slice":2,"box":[100,200,300,400]}]}。degraded_version 必须为整数 1 或 2；没有适用维度或区域时使用空数组。
